author: Troy Crites
text: I was very impressed with Nick. He is highly knowledgeable, hard working, responsive to his customers schedule constraints, and reasonably priced. Highly recommend!  Here’s a photo of him, pumping out our septic that he helped find and dig to the access point.

author: Gary January
text: Nick was prompt, knowledgeable and fair. Told us that our septic did not need to be pumped. So he repaired the drain from tank to the field and added a riser. I have personally repaired a few septic tank and installed a septic system so I am familiar with all that he did the correct way!!!

author: Debbie B
text: Nick was great! And very through. I will definitely use Patriot Septic from now on. Pricing was very reasonable too.
